plug_instrumentation.CE_validity_guard: The conservative buffer corner uses chargerVIN>=3.8V. PGOOD alone does not establish this with a low battery. Require an independently qualified source bound or validPGOOD plus a calibratedVBAT lower-confidence bound>=3.8V, because BQPGOOD requiresVIN>VBAT+positiveVIN_DT. Otherwise CE_valid=false; positive ISET can still establish observed charging. No bareCHGhigh/zeroISET Done.
plug_instrumentation.TS_validity: TS voltage observes the charger's pack NTC node, not an independent calibrated temperature or a software safety override. Open/high saturation and stale/configuration faults are invalid.
plug_instrumentation.USB100_default_termination: Comparator0.027..0.040 of programmed charge current, typical0.033;8.87k gives nominal3.311mA. This is not a software Done threshold.
plug_instrumentation.source_status: Existing PGOOD and numeric J6/J7 interface remain unchanged. Source loss does not confirm physical removal.

bridge_initialization: Keep NINA CTS deasserted until receiver FIFO and flow thresholds are ready; SC16 RTS defaults HIGH after reset.
Wait local supply/reset and actual crystal startup; verify scratchpad/configuration readback.
LCR=0xBF, EFR=0x10 to enable enhanced functions without autoflow.
LCR=0x03, MCR=0x04, TCR=0x6C (halt48/resume24), then clear MCR bit2. TCR must be valid BEFORE autoRTS is enabled.
LCR=0x83, DLL=8, DLH=0, then LCR=0x03; explicitly initialize divisor because these registers are not reset by the top-level reset.
FCR=0x07 enables and resets both FIFOs; wait at least2 stableXTAL clocks before FIFO accesses.
LCR=0xBF, EFR=0xD0 enables autoRTS and autoCTS, then restoreLCR=0x03. Software XON/XOFF remains disabled.
Initialize unused GPIO directions/latches intentionally; GPIO0 controls NINA DSR, GPIO1 observes NINA DTR. Do not confuse their RS232 host/module names.
Enable RX-data and RX-line-status interrupts, handle RX-timeout and overruns, and bound each I2C work slice. FIFO64 bytes can fill in5.56ms at continuous line rate.
case_radio.clock_and_recovery: Main MSI4.2MHz and PA13/14 SWD remain unchanged; HSE is not selected. Native plugUSB/Power/Mode ROM recovery stay physically independent.

case_radio.isolation: TMUX1511RSVR powered fromRADIO_3V3 isolates SDA/SCL/IRQ. Three SEL pins follow hardware-gatedRADIO_ACTIVE_EN, so source loss opens them before local3V3decay. Powered-offI/O<=3.6V and Main3V3max must be qualified.
case_radio.reset: Local TPS3808G33DBVR open-drain reset supervisesRADIO_3V3 and resets SC16/NINA. NINA's55ms is a maximum pin-reset-release time, not a guaranteed complete firmware startup time; wait startupURC and AT handshake.
case_radio.IRQ_pullups: LocalSC16IRQ needs manufacturer1k; proposed hostPH0pull10k. Include both currents and bus pullups in added radio allocation.
case_radio.hard_allocation_scope: Limiteroutput max plus inputIq and newly added host-side pulls; not merely local radio load. Short-response overshoot/inrush and passive input faults require separate qualification.
case_radio.coupled_UV_candidate: R10739.2k and both UVRSET4.22ohm; no frozen budget/board mutation
